description: This file defines an internal interface 'IGrainCancellationTokenRuntime' in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which includes a method for cancelling grain-related cancellation tokens asynchronously. It is part of the abstraction layer related to cancellation handling within the Orleans actor framework.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a grain cancellation token identified by 'id', affecting associated grain references and token source.
